spans.s:
mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं)
A lump, a heap, a cluster, a quantity or collection.
mf. (-ण्डः-ण्डी)
An oblation to deceased ancestors, as a ball or lump of meat, or rice, mixed up with milk, curds, flowers, &c. and offered to the manes at the several Śrāddhas, by the nearest surviving relations.
m. (-ण्डः)
1 A ball, a globe.
2 A mouthful, or roundish lump of food, considered as equivalent to a mouthful.
3 Presenting water or cake to a deceased relation.
4 The body.
5 The side immediately below the armpit.
6 A part of a house; a sort of portico or shed, in front of the door.
7 Coarse, gross, thick, solid.
8 Strength, power.
9

Myrrh.
10

Frankincense.
11

The China rose.
12

Food.
13

Flesh, meat.
14 The projection of an elephant's frontal sinus.
15 The embryo or fetus in an early stage of gestation.
16 A sum, (in arithmetic^1.)
17 (In astronomy) The twenty-fourth part of the quadrant of a circle, or 3°-45'
n. (-पडं)
1 Livelihood, means of living.
2

Iron.
3

Fresh butter.
f. (-ण्डी)
1 A long gourd, (Cucurbita lagenaria.)
2 A sort of palm, (Phœnix dactylifera.)
3 A flowering shrub, (Tabernæmontana coronaria flor. plen.)
4 Performance of certain gesticulations, accompanying the silent repetition of prayers, &c. in meditation on real or divine knowledge.
5 The nave of a wheel.
6 A house.
E.
पिडि to heap, to gather, to collect, &c. aff. अच् or घञ्, fem. aff. ङीप्.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

Incense.
2

A goblin, a demon.
E.
पिण्ड as above, and कन् added.

m. (-न्दः)
See पिण्डालु.

mf. (-रः-री)
A sort of date tree.
E.
पिण्ड a lump, a cluster, and खर्ज्जूर the date.

m. (-सः)
Gum myrrh; also पिण्ड and गोस severally.

m. (-कः)
Incense, olibanum.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Who or what gives the funeral cake to deceased ancestors.
2 One who supports or feeds another.
m. (-दः)
1 The nearest male relation.
2 A patron, a master.
E.
पिण्ड, and द who or what gives.

n. (-नं)
Presentation of the obsequial cake.
E.
पिण्ड, and दान giving.

m. (-नः)
A mound or bank.

n. (-नं)
Presenting obsequial cakes to the manes.
E.
पिण्ड, and निर्वपन offering funeral oblations.

m. (-दः)
An elephant.
E.
पिण्ड a lump of flesh, and पाद a foot: also पिण्डपाद्य.

n. (-ष्पः)
1 The flower of the Asoca tree, (Jonesia Asoca.)
2 The China rose.
3 A lotus.
4 A flower, (Tabernæmontana coronaria.)
E.
पिण्ड a cluster, and पुष्प a flower.

m. (-कः)
A potherb, (Chenopodium album.)
E.
पिण्ड a lump, पुष्प a flower, कन् added.

f. (-ला)
A bitter gourd.
E.
पिण्ड a lump, फल fruit.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Living, breathing, having no intellectual existence.
E.
पिण्ड, माच only, उपजीविन् subsisting.

f. (-स्वा)
A sort of grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.)
E.
पिण्ड a lump, and मुस्ता Cyperus.

n. (-लं)
The carrot, (Daucus carota.)
E.
पिण्ड lump of flesh, and मूल a root; also with कन् added पिण्डमूलक.

m. (-लः)
A bridge, a causeway, a passage over a stream or ravine, &c. or a mound raised to form a path across inundated fields.
E.
पिण्ड a heap, (of earth, &c.) and ला to get, aff. ड.

m. (-जः)
A flowering shrub, (Oleander odorum.)
E.
पिण्ड, and वीज seed.

m. (-सः)
A beggar, a mendicant living upon alms.
E.
पिण्ड a ball of rice, &c. सद to go or get, aff. ड.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
A beggar.
E.
पिण्ड a piece of meat, आश who eats; also पिण्डाशनः and पिण्डाशिन् (-शी)

m. (-तः)
Incense.
E.
पिण्ड the same, अत to be, aff. अच्.

n. (-भ्रं)
Hail.
E.
पिण्ड a lump, and अभ्र a cloud.

n. (-सं)
Steel.
E.
पिण्ड, and अयस iron.

m. (-रः)
1 A keeper or attendant on buffaloes.
2 A cowherd.
3 A beggar, a religious mendicant.
4 A tree, (Trewia nudiflora.)
E.
पिण्ड a heap, ऋ to go, aff. अप्.

m. (-लुः)
An esculent and medical root, described as sweet, cooling, and diuretic^1.
E.
पिण्ड a lump, and आलु an esculent root.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

f. (-ण्डिः)
The nave of a wheel.
E.
पिडि to collect, (the spokes,) aff. इन्; also पिण्डी and पिण्डिका.

f. (-का)
1 The nave of a wheel.
2 The instep.
3 A stool or seat of various shapes and dimensions.
E.
पिण्डी as above, and कन् added.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Multiplied, added.
2 Counted, numbered.
3 Thick, massy, lumpish.
4 Collected, heaped together.
E.
पिण्ड a lump, a heap, and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-ण्डी-ण्डिनी-ण्डि)
Having a Piṇḍa or ball of food, (a ceremony, an ancestor, &c.)
m. (-ण्डी)
1 A beggar.
2 An offerer of oblations.
E.
पिण्ड, and इनि aff.

m. (-लः)
1 A bridge, a mound, a causeway.
2 An astrologer, an arithmetician, a calculator of nativities, &c.
f. (-ला)
A sort of cucumber, (C. madraspatanus.)
E.
पिण्ड a heap, &c. इलच् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-णं)
Heaping, making up into a lump or ball.
E.
पिण्ड, and करण making, च्वि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Made into a lump or ball.
E.
पिण्ड, and कृत made, च्वि augm.

m. (-कः)
1 A tree, (Vangueria spinosa, Rox.)
2 A shrub, (Tabernæmontana coronaria.)
3 A plant, commonly Marüa; see मरुवक.
E.
पिण्डी a plant, तन to spread, to resemble, aff. ड and कन् added.

m. (-रः)
A plant, a species of tabernæmontana.
E.
पिण्डी the same, and तगर T. coronaria.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Lumped, heaped, made up in a lump or ball.
E.
पिण्ड, and भूत become, च्वि augm.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Sapless, juiceless, arid, dry.
m. (-रः)
1 The pomegranate.
2 Cuttle-fish bone.
E.
पिण्ड a ball, &c. ऋ to go, to resemble, aff. अप्, form irr.

m. (-रः)
A cot quean, an effeminate braggart.
E.
पिण्डी a house, and शूर a hero.

n. (-णं)
Participating in obsequial offerings, presenting them to common ancestors.
E.
पिण्ड, and उद्वरण sharing.

f. (-लिः)
Orts, leavings of a meal, or fragments dropped from the mouth.
E.
पिडि to heap, aff. ओलि.

f. (-ण्या)
Heart-pea, (Cardiospermum haliacacabum.)
E.
पण to praise, ण्यत् aff., and इ substituted for the radical vowel: see पण्या.

m. (-कः)
1 The sediments of seeds, &c. ground for oil; oil-cake, or the seeds after expression.
2

Saffron.
3

Asafœtida.
4 Incense.
E.
पिषु to pound or bruise, deriv. irr.
